headline: Chinese-Backed Mine in DRC Faces $6.3 Million Pollution Lawsuit
summary: Twenty-seven residents near a Chinese-controlled copper and cobalt mine in the Democratic Republic of Congo are suing the operator for $6.3 million, alleging environmental pollution and health risks.
why: Environmental, social, and governance (ESG) litigation poses financial and operational risks for mining companies, potentially impacting project timelines and operating costs.
